setup: Grab the parallel handles, palms facing
Hang with straight arms, legs still
execution: Drive your elbows down to your ribs
Lower all the way to straight arms
faults: Don't kick or swing your legs
Don't stop short of straight arms
Don't crane your chin to finish

notes: Step down onto a box or bench at the end of a set rather than dropping.
Add weight with a dip belt only once bodyweight reps are smooth; log the added weight as added.
If pain lingers or comes back, stop this exercise and get it checked by a physio or doctor.
stopIf: Pain that changes how you move

guideBrief.cameraNote: Side view at chest height, parallel handles near the top of frame seen side-on. Whole body in frame at the bottom position.

keyPositions.label: Hang
keyPositions.describe: Hanging from parallel handles, palms facing each other about shoulder width. Arms straight, legs together and still, ribs down.

keyPositions.label: Top
keyPositions.describe: Chin above the handles, upper chest close to them. Elbows down by the ribs and slightly in front. Legs still together, no swing.

ikHints: Body rises in a near-vertical line
emphasise: Elbows drive down to the ribs
